directories.description: When a session-start sweep step last ran — one `folio-sweep-mark/v1` JSON per check, replaced by each run that read its input. Bean `rq8s`, owner ruling 2026-10-10: a skipped `check:session-staleness` is visible after the terminal scrolls.
directories._source_comment: Kept on its own per-graph state branch (owner, 2026-10-03, bean laqs) and mounted by `bun run cat state:mount`: a sweep mark is generated state a running process writes, not reviewed content. Declared on main first (tools#150), which `check:state-on-main` correctly refused as a NEW state directory on main; main drops `marks/` in the same commit that declares this source, because `mountTip` refuses a path the checkout still tracks. Empty until the first sweep writes a mark — `check:kind-validators` reads that as a determined empty, not EXAMINED NOTHING.
